tool_args.rationale: The prior submission failed because predict referenced an undefined global parameter. This version defines a module-level parameter store populated by fit, initializes latent z from each irregular shifted-time prefix (or mem_conv), and uses numerical least squares plus RK4 for the specified coupled ODE.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight trajectories are now available, satisfying the source note's minimum for numerical identification of the four coupled-ODE parameters.
Already acquired; further sampling is not justified before fitting and checking fresh confirmation.
Its snapshot response does not account for the observed history-conditioned transient lag; the verified ODE mechanism is the better-supported candidate.
